site_evidence.note: Landing-page source read live on 2026-11-23 through the W3C Nu HTML Checker (validator.w3.org/nu/?doc=<url>&showsource=yes), which returns the served HTML with script tags intact, plus a direct fetch of the same pages. Tags found: GA4.

promise_gap: Ad: 'Switch to Visiontek Solar and turn sunlight into savings. Our smart system powers your home directly, stores extra energy for the night and helps lower your monthly bill.'

Backed in part. The site sells exactly what the ad names - RISE+ (on-grid inverter), FUTURE+ (hybrid inverter), VAULT+ (LFP battery storage) and PULSE+ (panel-level optimiser) - but publishes no prices, no savings figures and no installation service, so the 'savings' promise has no numbers behind it on the page.
Ad: 'Switch to solar with Visiontek Solar Solutions and take a smarter step towards managing your energy needs.'

The click never reaches the page that answers this. The ad goes to Instagram (confirmed on the card), and the homepage has no contact form, no pricing and no testimonials - the enquiry form lives on /contact-us/, which paid traffic never sees.
Ad: 'The right time to consider solar? It's now.'

The site's only conversion path is WhatsApp (header CTA, banner and floating button, all wa.me/+919701601421) - there is no tel: click-to-call on the homepage and no form, so a visitor who prefers to call or fill a form must leave the homepage.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
